::: {#exm-tree-level}
#### Levels in the phone tree

In the phone tree (@exm-phone-tree), as @fig-phone marks,

- the root $a$ is at level (@def-tree-level) 0;
- $b$, $c$ and $d$ are at level 1;
- $e$, $f$ and $g$ are at level 2;
- $h$ is at level 3.

The level of a member is the number of calls the news passes through to reach that member,
which @sol-phone-calls found for $h$.

:::
